title: Missing SPA rewrite/fallback hosting configuration
file_path_and_line: package.json:6-12; root directory (no vercel.json, netlify.toml, public/_redirects, or server.ts)
evidence: Inspected root directory and package.json. Build outputs static SPA dist/ with pushState routes (/calculator/*, /calculators/*, /all-calculators), but no host rewrite config or start script exists.
user_impact: Direct URL visits or page refreshes on any calculator or category route return HTTP 404 on standard static hosting.
minimum_fix: Add hosting rewrite rule (vercel.json / public/_redirects) rewriting non-asset routes to /index.html with 200 status.

title: Unknown URLs and invalid calculator IDs silently render Homepage (no 404 view)
evidence: parseUrlPath returns { view: 'home' } for unrecognized paths and unknown /calculator/:id slugs rather than an explicit 404 state.
user_impact: Broken links or typos fail silently without error messaging and create soft-404 SEO issues.
minimum_fix: Add a not-found AppView state in parseUrlPath and render a clean 404 recovery page with Search and Home links.

title: 3,753 fallback tools (85.8%) use generic synthetic formulas while labeled verified + 2 duplicate contracts collide
evidence: Node execution confirmed 3,753 unique tools use synthetic smartFields (a*b, a/b, a*1.25) while UI displays 'Free & verified' / 'Ready and Operational'. 2 duplicate contract IDs overwrite earlier copies (404 pass / 2 fail in contract batch test).
user_impact: Users on 85.8% of catalog pages can receive generic approximations presented as verified calculations; inventory-turnover-calc overwrites schema fields.
minimum_fix: Remove duplicate contracts for college-savings-529-calc and inventory-turnover-calc; mark synthetic fallback tools transparently as Formula Preview/Estimate with domain disclaimer instead of verified.

title: Sidebar 'Calculators' Tool Hub misroutes to Basic Math category
evidence: Sidebar toolboxHubs calls onNavigateCategoryDetail('calculators'), and getCategoryById('calculators') resolves to 'basic-math'.
user_impact: Clicking 'Calculators' in the Sidebar opens /calculators/calculators displaying only Basic Math instead of all calculators.
minimum_fix: Route Sidebar 'Calculators' hub item to navigateToAllCalculators (or /all-calculators).

title: Conflicting canonical domain origins (glovotools.io vs glovotools.app)
evidence: index.html declares canonical and og:url on https://glovotools.io whereas robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and App.tsx fallback use https://glovotools.app.
user_impact: Search engines receive split canonical and sitemap signals across two different domains.
minimum_fix: Standardize on one production domain across index.html, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and App.tsx.
